description: We're Nebula Collectors, a team mainly from Cumilla Collectorate School & College, Bangladesh, competing in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our project, “Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data,” combines NASA Earth observation, climate, soil, and crop data with AI-powered guidance to help farmers assess crop suitability, plan rotations, manage water, improve soil health, and prepare for weather risks—supporting smarter, more resilient, and sustainable agriculture.
